title: JCGS canonical-periodic three-seed capacity training
purpose: Obtain the first valid three-seed JCGS capacity result after exact CUDA attribution and canonical circular-endpoint correction.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 JCGS V1R2 from-scratch three-seed training: C01-C06 gradients, C07 checkpoint/refusal selection, C08 one zero-adaptation transfer; no C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User requested continuous autonomous execution and delegated best-method choices without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed V1/V1R system failures and synchronous attribution.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: Exact S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds and the only gradient source.
worlds.selection: C07 selects each checkpoint and one refusal threshold; C08 is one final zero-adaptation transfer only.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Exact V1/V1R schedule and augmentation. Five causal frames; one phase plus K positive closed gaps; canonical periodic endpoints; singleton gap 360 degrees; stable phase and finite fail-closed; no class/loss weights.

teacher.source: Exact exit centers, widths, profiles, local axis and global width/height/slope/curvature from frozen procedural geometry.
teacher.use: Unchanged cyclic-start invariant proper phase, gap, uncertainty and geometry losses; no identity.
teacher.valid_mask: Exact exit and global geometry masks unchanged.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph; later edges remain physical-traversal-only.

split.fit: C01-C06 gradients and fixed circular augmentation only.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 minimum total loss selects checkpoints; three-seed cyclic alignment selects maximum-recall refusal at precision at least 0.995.
split.historical_pollution_audit: All seeds restart from scratch; no V1/V1R checkpoint, optimizer state or prediction initializes or selects V1R2.

methods.main: Three from-scratch 789650-parameter JCGS models: one circular phase and a positive closed K-gap simplex jointly decode complete exit geometry, using canonical periodic endpoint indexing.
methods.baseline: COUST C07/C08 strict exact-set overall 0.4156/0.3870, K3 0.00240/0.00179, K4 0/0.00433; V1/V1R have no scientific result.
methods.fallback: Any non-finite, safety/K3/K4/gain/geometry/system failure seals FAIL before graph; no resume, retry, seed selection, wider matching or planner compensation.

acceptance.continuous_exit_set: One C07 threshold gives exit precision >=0.995 and recall >=0.50 on C07 and C08.
acceptance.cardinality: Raw count accuracy >=0.80, deployed action macro-F1 >=0.80, raw and safe exact sets >=0.50 on both.
acceptance.complex_structure: K3 raw/safe exact >=0.40/0.30 and K4 >=0.20/0.10 on both.
acceptance.baseline_gain: Overall, K3 and K4 strict exact sets gain >=0.05 absolute over COUST on both.
acceptance.global_geometry: Axis <=10 degrees; width/height <=2m; slope <=2 degrees; curvature <=0.02/m.
acceptance.system: Exactly 34110 steps; all finite; C08 checkpoint=0; C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner=0.

failure_policy: Fail closed. Preserve V1/V1R separately. No retry or scientific adaptation after C08.
retention: Three checkpoints/histories/summaries, compact predictions, metrics, figures/source, environment, commands, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential CUDA trainings plus frozen evaluation
